decisions.question: Coordinates of a C or N change entry of a transaction whose target element a command of the same transaction created.
decisions.decision: A transaction is one operation with one Report/2 (inputRevision = baseRevision, outputRevision = the committed revision): a change entry has its source in the before-tree and its result in the committed tree. A target that a command or recipe of the same transaction created has no source location, so its source is {domain: none, pointer: null, targetId: null, provenance: generated} with no before value, and its result is the committed location with provenance generated; a target of the before-tree keeps exact coordinates, its before-tree pointer included when an earlier stage moved it. Observed findings keep the coordinates of the linted candidate and an unavailable result.
design: L632-L633 (one root transaction, one final report)
L751 (before from the immutable source, after from the final result)
L755 (immutable source pointers, result pointers in the final output, never intermediate arrays)
L766 (a removal does not shift a source pointer; generated port)
L510 (findings resolved in the linted index)
harmonization: B9 (a created element's source is the generated coordinate)
interpretation 1 of the lot-3 expectations README
decisions.rejected: Staged-tree coordinates (tree/exact source and exact result for the writes on a created task, as the canvas replay produced): the location does not exist in the document of inputRevision and the staged tree is an intermediate state, never published (L633, L637).
decisions.lot5: The lot-5 seal has no change entry on a created target: its only change entries are six complete/set writes on Process elements of the input (exact on both sides, as here), and its findings on created tasks (for example lot5-context-001-append-task-programmatic) are observed entries at tree/exact source with an unavailable result, the convention these cases already use.
